title: Shifting Q4 walkthroughs for year-end ops freeze (customer impacts + handoffs)
text:
Shifting Q4 walkthroughs for year-end ops freeze (customer impacts + handoffs)

["From: Raj Patel <raj@acmepayments.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@acmepayments.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request to move next week's product walkthrough

Hi Soojin,

Quick note — several of our folks will be at RSA and we also have an internal change freeze the week of Nov 22 for scheduled year-end ops. Can we push the walkthrough currently slated for Nov 23? Preferably to the first week of December.

I know Q4 schedules are tight; if there are shorter slots or a recorded walkthrough available that would help as well.

Thanks,
Raj
Senior PM, AcmePayments

", "From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj@acmepayments.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request to move next week's product walkthrough

Raj — thanks for the heads up and totally understood. We run a couple of options below; please let me know which works best and we'll lock it in: 

- Option A — Dec 1, 10:00–10:45 PT (live walkthrough, full Q&A)
- Option B — Dec 3, 14:00–14:30 PT (shorter executive summary + follow-up recording)
- Option C — Keep Nov 23 but record and share the full session; follow-up office hours the week of Dec 6 (asynchronous compromise)

I've attached an updated calendar (.ics) with the tentative slots. Ben and Tessa are on copy to coordinate resources — Ben if we need to reassign the demo owner for the Dec 1 slot, Tessa can take point if Ben is in EMEA travel that week. Vivek — FYI on the SLA/contract timeline if shifting impacts milestones.

If none of these work, happy to surface two more windows after Dec 6.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: updated-demo-slots.ics (calendar with three tentative slots)
", "From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request to move next week's product walkthrough

Looping in a quick plan. I'm scheduled to be at RSA Nov 29–Dec 2, so I won't be available for the Dec 1 slot. Tessa — can you lead the live Dec 1 10:00 PT session if Raj picks Option A? I'll prepare the product slides and a short runbook for you.

Soojin — I've drafted a one‑page handoff note that outlines talking points, anticipated questions around private deployments, and top blockers we should surface. Adding as attachment. If Raj prefers the shorter Dec 3 slot we should cut the deep-dive section and push technical Qs to an office-hours follow-up.

Ben
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: handoff-note-AcmePayments.pdf
", "From: Raj Patel <raj@acmepayments.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@acmepayments.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T16:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request to move next week's product walkthrough

Thanks everyone — Option A (Dec 1, 10:00 PT) works best for our org. Tessa, appreciate you taking the lead and Ben for the handoff note. We'll send the calendar invite once you confirm the final invite time and attendee list.

One ask — can you include a 20-minute block focusing on integration with our VPC/on-prem setup (we'll have one of our infra folks join).

Talk soon,
Raj

"]
